The original spec ('rising by MORE than the Q1 pace of +$3.3B') WAS DEFECTIVE and would have resolved TRUE on an information-free print. *** SHADE's finding, INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED BY CREED against MBA primary releases: +$3.3B is a SEASONAL TROUGH, not a run-rate. Verified series: Q3-2025 +$12.1B | Q4-2025 +$11.5B (+1.5%, stock $774B) | Q1-2026 +$3.3B (+0.4%, stock $775B) | H1-2025 +$4.4B across BOTH quarters combined. H2-2025 ran ~5x H1-2025. So a +$11B Q2 print would have satisfied the old spec while being an entirely normal H2-magnitude quarter carrying ZERO information about ARI. || BUT CREED DID NOT ADOPT SHADE'S PROPOSED ~+$20B BAR - it over-corrects by the SAME error class in the opposite direction. That bar anchors to the Q3/Q4 (H2) norm of +$11-12B, but Q2 IS A SEASONALLY WEAK H1 QUARTER: the H1-2025 average was ~+$2.2B/qtr and Q1-2026 printed +$3.3B. The no-ARI counterfactual for Q2-2026 is therefore ~+$2-4B, and ARI's ~$9B landing visibly would produce ~+$11-13B - which WOULD FAIL a $20B bar. A $20B bar can resolve FALSE even if the ENTIRE $9B lands in the line. || +$10.0B is set as ~3x the highest observed H1 quarterly change and ~4.5x the H1-2025 per-quarter average - reachable essentially only if a large DISCRETE block lands. || MEASUREMENT BASIS FIXED TOO: MBA rounds to the nearest $B and REVISES prior quarters - $774B (Q4) + $3.3B != $775B (Q1) as published. A threshold that subtracts a remembered prior stock is fragile; this one reads the change off the carrying release. || CONFIDENCE 65% -> 30%, and the cut is a GENUINE PROBABILITY UPDATE, not a resolvability trim: SHADE read Annex A s2.8 of the DEFM14A (acc. 0001193125-26-119995) directly - Athene may, BY PRIVATE WRITTEN NOTICE 10 business days before closing, designate Affiliates, MANAGED ACCOUNTS or PORTFOLIO COMPANIES (incl. the ACRA co-invest vehicles) to acquire ALL OR ANY PORTION of the assets, and the split was never disclosed. The MBA line derives from the Fed's US LIFE-INSURANCE-COMPANY sector, which does not contain those vehicles. That is an explicit CONTRACTUAL right to route the assets outside this instrument - information CREED did not have at Made_Date. || RE-SPEC IS LEGITIMATE, NOT A RETIRE+REPLACE, per finding_rebased_metric_check_made_date: test whether the NEW metric was already true at Made_Date - Q1-2026's +$3.3B does not clear +$10B, so it was not. || THREE BRANCHES PRESERVED, branch 2 now names the s2.8 case explicitly: BOTH 006 and 010 move = migration confirmed and visible. 010 MOVES BUT 006 DOES NOT = the assets landed WHOLLY OR LARGELY outside the Fed US life-insurance sector (ACRA / managed-account / portfolio-company vehicles); the MBA line is a BAD INSTRUMENT for this channel - A FINDING, NOT A MISS. *** BRANCH-2 WORDING AMENDED 2026-07-27 on a SHADE ask, ACCEPTED: it must read "WHOLLY OR LARGELY outside", never a bare "outside". DEFM14A Annex A s2.8 permits designation of "all or any PORTION" of the Assets, so a PARTIAL landing is the MODAL outcome of a clause written that way, not an edge case - and a partial (~$4-5B, printing ~+$7-9B) resolves FALSE and is INDISTINGUISHABLE from full exclusion at this bar. The bar is binary; the underlying quantity is continuous and partitionable by PRIVATE notice. LEVEL DELIBERATELY NOT MOVED: +$10.0B is well-chosen for the full-landing case and CREED will not tune a bar to an unobservable split. The cost is RECORDED rather than engineered away - a half-landing must not be written up as a clean instrument failure. *** NEITHER MOVES = the deal did not land where CREED and SHADE both think it did, and the migration read needs re-derivation. || GRADE 006 AND 010 TOGETHER - they test ONE transaction on two surfaces; grading them independently double-counts it.
